technical.summary: Long-term structure is bullish but short-term momentum is conflicted with death cross, oversold oscillators without confirmation, and negative volume signals—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 66 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Mixed congressional activity with no clear directional bias; broad market sentiment neutral; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (295.5) with imminent CPI event in 2 days creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 66 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, Supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud) provides macro tailwind and price near support (343.16) offers defined risk entry for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Acute macro crisis (VIX 295.5, CPI in 2 days), short-term death cross, oversold oscillators without confirmation, negative volume (CMF, OBV), zero fundamental conviction, and earnings risk in 66 days create overwhelming headwinds that invalidate technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200, Supertrend, Ichimoku) is bullish and price is near support, but short-term momentum is broken with death cross, oversold oscillators without confirmation, and negative volume signals that contradict entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis regime (295.5) with CPI event in 2 days creates acute macro stress that can trigger sharp reversals regardless of technical setup; earnings in 66 days adds secondary timing risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on weakness; technical, fundamental, and risk agents all score low; only debate bull case is macro tailwind from long-term structure, which is insufficient given crisis conditions.
decision.portfolio_note: Already hold ACN position and 3 other IT names in 30-position portfolio; sector concentration and existing ticker exposure further reduce conviction for new entry.
